category: managed OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs (observability database on ClickHouse)

free_tier.stated: Uptrace Cloud is free up to 50 GB and 5,000 timeseries per month, then from $0.075/GB with automatic volume discounts; unlimited users, services and hosts. A separate free trial offers 1 TB of storage and 100,000 timeseries with no card required.
free_tier.notes: The ongoing free allowance is 50 GB per month and 5,000 timeseries; the 1 TB / 100,000-timeseries figure is a signup trial. Metrics are billed per million ingested datapoints from $0.025 per 1M.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no single-object cap is published; the free Cloud allowance is 50 GB per month of ingested spans/logs plus 5,000 timeseries, which are volume quotas rather than a per-object cap.

retention.stated: Uptrace Cloud keeps all data for 4 weeks (28 days) by default; longer cold storage on S3 or HDD is available for up to 100 weeks at $0.01 per GB-month for spans and $0.20 per 1,000 timeseries-month for metrics.
retention.notes: 28 days is the default retention; it can be extended via paid cold storage.

egress.terms: Sending data from AWS or GCP incurs outbound fees; the vendor says OTel Arrow cuts bandwidth 30-70% versus standard OTLP and compresses telemetry 15-30x. Ingestion above the free allowance is charged per GB, not egress from Uptrace.

interface_detail: OpenTelemetry OTLP ingest for traces, metrics and logs; Prometheus, Vector, FluentBit and CloudWatch ingest; a built-in MCP server queryable from AI assistants using the existing Uptrace session token; UQL and PromQL-compatible query engines and a web UI.
tooling: OpenTelemetry SDKs and Collector, Prometheus, Vector, FluentBit, Grafana data-source support; the self-hosted Community Edition that the user installs and runs is the last resort
chaining: A hosted Uptrace Cloud endpoint takes OTLP telemetry from existing OpenTelemetry instrumentation; self-hosting the AGPL Community Edition on a rented or free machine is the last-resort path when the hosted free allowance is insufficient.

limits.value: 50 GB free per month and 5,000 timeseries per month on Uptrace Cloud Free; beyond that from $0.075/GB
Metrics billing starts at $0.025 per 1M ingested datapoints and decreases with volume; minimum supported collection interval is 10 seconds
default retention 4 weeks (28 days); longer storage only via paid cold storage up to 100 weeks

binding_note: The 50 GB/month and 5,000-timeseries free allowance is the first ceiling a free user hits; retention is a fixed 28-day default and per-object caps are not published.

identity_cost.detail: Cloud signup is a free account with no card required for the trial; billing is handled by Paddle by credit card or bank transfer after signup. A public live demo can be explored without any account.

reliability_note: Cloud data is stored in Hetzner's Germany datacenters with backups in Finland; 99.9% uptime is listed. Sending from AWS or GCP incurs outbound fees; dropped sampled data costs $0.01 per GB.
confidence_note: All stated values come from first-party Uptrace pricing, homepage and signup pages captured on 2026-11-19. The exact signup form fields were not visible in the browser capture and identity is recorded at the level the page shows.
